lifecycleScripts.afterStart: wp-env run --config=.wp-env.e2e.json cli sh -c 'sudo apk add --no-cache --quiet git; git config --global user.name "VersionPress E2E"; git config --global user.email e2e@example.com; wp plugin is-active versionpress || (wp plugin activate versionpress && wp vp activate --yes)'
